# RESULTS (auto-generated by scripts/build_release.py on 2026-10-01T05:35Z; do not edit by hand)

All figures are historical simulations. Execution is modelled (quoted candle ask/bid on Kalshi with the taker fee; Polymarket midpoint plus an assumed half-spread), not demonstrated fills. "Sharpe on capital" divides daily P&L by a fixed capital equal to the maximum daily gross cost over the window (so every day fits inside it) and includes every calendar day in the evaluation window (zero when inactive). The 1-lot P&L Sharpe is the older diagnostic and is not a return-on-capital statistic.
